shared_tail.surface: صالح بن عقبة بن قيس بن سمعان بن أبي ربيحة

notes: «جميعا عن صالح» writes Salih once for both routes, so he is the shared tail; the blessing after Muhammad ibn Musa and the status «مولى رسول اللّه» are left out; the compiler's own «فقد رويته» is the head of every chain and is not written
